description: Enriches company domains with structured signals from CrustData - funding rounds, headcount growth, department growth, and recent hires. Use when the user wants to pull company signals, enrich domains with funding/growth/hiring data, check who recently joined a company, find new hires at a domain, get headcount trends, or anything involving CrustData enrichment. Also triggers on: "run crustdata signals", "enrich these domains", "pull funding data", "who joined recently", "headcount growth for these companies", "department growth", "recent hires at", "crustdata enrich".
